name: Vinyasa Flow Studio

pages.name: MemberSchedulePage
pages.description: Weekly timetable grid (7 columns by day). Each cell shows a ClassSessionCard with instructor name, level badge, spots-remaining pill, and duration. Filters above for instructor, level, time-of-day. Clicking a session opens the 3-step quick-book modal.

pages.name: BookingConfirmPage
pages.description: 3-step quick-book flow: Step 1 session summary (instructor, room, duration, level); Step 2 credit or payment confirmation; Step 3 confirmation with add-to-calendar link.

pages.name: MemberDashboardPage
pages.description: Member home: upcoming bookings list, credits remaining, active subscription plan, and quick links to browse schedule and manage membership.

pages.name: MemberBookingsPage
pages.description: Member's booking history and upcoming classes. Status filter tabs (Upcoming, Past, Cancelled). Each row shows session title, instructor, date, status, waitlist position if applicable.

pages.name: MemberMembershipPage
pages.description: Active subscription detail: plan name, credits remaining, expiry, renewal status. Side-by-side plan comparison cards below for upgrade/downgrade.

pages.name: PlansPage
pages.description: Plan comparison card grid: drop-in, class packs, unlimited monthly. Best Value badge on isFeatured plan. Price in plain language, no hidden maths. Subscribe button per plan.

pages.name: MemberReviewsPage
pages.description: Member's submitted reviews list with star rating, instructor, session, and date.

pages.name: InstructorDashboardPage
pages.description: Instructor home: today's classes, upcoming schedule, avg rating tile, total students taught this month, and link to manage availability.

pages.name: InstructorSchedulePage
pages.description: Instructor's own class calendar. Week view. Clicking a session opens attendance management for that session.

pages.name: InstructorAttendancePage
pages.description: Attendance roster for a specific session. List of booked members with status (confirmed, attended, no_show). Toggle attendance per member.

pages.name: InstructorAvailabilityPage
pages.description: Recurring-weekly availability grid (Mon-Sun rows, time slot columns). Instructor blocks or opens time slots. Changes propagate live to the member-facing schedule.

pages.name: InstructorReviewsPage
pages.description: Instructor's received reviews with rating, comment, session, member display name, and date. Aggregate rating chart at top.

pages.name: AdminDashboardPage
pages.description: Studio overview: revenue this month, total active members, classes scheduled, utilisation rate. Charts for revenue by month, bookings by class level, top instructors by rating.

pages.name: AdminSessionsPage
pages.description: Kanban of class sessions grouped by status (Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled). Cards show title, instructor, room, time, spots. Admin can cancel or reassign instructor.

pages.name: AdminSessionDetailPage
pages.description: Full session detail: instructor, room, bookings list, waitlist, attendance summary. Admin actions to cancel or reassign instructor.

pages.name: AdminRoomsPage
pages.description: Room management list. Name, capacity, amenities, active status. Add/edit/deactivate rooms.

pages.name: AdminPlansPage
pages.description: Membership plan management. List of all plans with type, price, credits, interval, active status. Add/edit plans.

pages.name: AdminMembersPage
pages.description: Member management list filtered to role=member. Name, email, active subscription, credits, last active. Click to view member detail.

pages.name: AdminMemberDetailPage
pages.description: Member detail: profile, active subscription, booking history, credits log, reviews left. Admin can adjust credits or cancel subscription.

pages.name: AdminInstructorsPage
pages.description: Instructor roster. Name, specialties, avg rating, active status. Invite new instructor.

pages.name: AdminInstructorDetailPage
pages.description: Instructor detail: bio, certifications, specialties, upcoming sessions, avg rating, reviews. Admin can deactivate or substitute instructor.

pages.name: AdminSettingsPage
pages.description: Studio-wide settings: cancellation window hours, waitlist confirmation window minutes, timezone, studio name, notification preferences.

pages.name: AdminAnalyticsPage
pages.description: Revenue analytics: monthly revenue chart, class utilisation by room, top instructors by student count and rating, membership type breakdown, churn rate.

pages.name: Add member
pages.description: Internal creation form for member. Public path is /signup; this page lets admins and other internal roles add a member directly (walk-ins, CV imports, admin-initiated registration).

assumptions: Online payment processing — resolved: Stripe integration modeled via stripeSubscriptionId on Subscription; PCI scope acknowledged. Full Stripe webhook flows deferred to post-MVP.
Recurring vs ad-hoc sessions — resolved: ClassSession has a recurringRuleId FK stub; admin creates individual sessions for MVP. Recurring rule entity is a v2 concern.
Private 1:1 sessions — resolved: out of scope. Only group classes modeled.
Multi-location — resolved: single studio with multiple Rooms. No site/location entity added.
Cancellation refund policy — resolved: configurable via StudioSetting (key=cancellationWindowHours). Late cancellations forfeit credits; on-time cancellations restore them.
Instructor payroll — resolved: out of scope. Platform does not calculate instructor pay.
description: Multi-role yoga studio platform for class booking, membership management, instructor scheduling, and admin analytics.
